Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Meera - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Isha - 11 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Ishaan (excited): "That's easy."

[Ishaan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Anjali (softly): "Ishaan, look at this."

[Ishaan drinks a glass of water.]

Ishaan: "Let's see."

[Ishaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Ishaan (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Ishaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Ishaan (laughing): "And then?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Isha: "Ishaan, look over here."

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Ishaan: "This is amazing!"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[The sun is blazing and Ishaan is sweating.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ishaan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Anjali and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan stands up.]

Meera: "That was such a fun day!"
